# GitHub Social Preview Image

> **How to apply this:**
> 1. The SVG source is at `docs/social-preview.svg`.
> 2. Render it to a 1280×640 PNG using any SVG-to-PNG tool:
>    - `npx @resvg/resvg-js docs/social-preview.svg -o social-preview.png`
>    - or open in Figma / Sketch / browser and export as PNG.
> 3. Upload the PNG at **Settings → General → Social preview** on GitHub.

The preview should show:
- The project name `agent-memory`
- A short tagline
- Key feature icons
- Brand colours (purple/blue gradient)

GitHub requires PNG or JPG, 1280×640 px, max 1 MB.
